name: subtitle
label: Subtitle / context line
default: India ops · Logging shifts worked for billing & payroll alignment

name: tooltip
label: Info-icon tooltip text
default: Log the shift you worked each day. Submissions lock at month-end.

name: shift_table
label: Day-entry table
hint: Table name. Must have columns u_user, u_date, u_shift_type (reference to catalogue), u_comment.

name: lock_table
label: Month-lock table
hint: Table name. Must have columns u_user, u_year, u_month, u_submitted_on.

name: catalog_table
label: Shift catalogue table
hint: Table name. Active rows are loaded live on every loadMonth. Must have columns name, description, rate, currency, effective_date, active, valid_till, u_color_hex.

name: summary_table
label: Aggregate summary table
hint: Table name. Stores weekly and monthly shift-type counts with rate snapshots. See README for full schema.

name: entitlement_table
label: CO entitlement table
hint: Table name. Tracks CO rights earned by compound OC shifts. See README for full schema.
